items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: I know Lester came up there and George refused to sign a contract with him.

ctx.x: No, not Amherst. Not Williams. Amherst isn't in Vermont, it's in my own state. Um, not Bennington, that's a women's college. I can't remember them all, but there were a great many. There were a great many of them. Then there was a St. Paul's, a preparatory school, prep school in Massachusetts very late. Uh, uh, uh, uh. Like that? Yes, Alvin Kershaw arranged the date. Oh, that's funny, he's never on that. And, uh, no, he's moved somewhere else. I don't know where. I'll have to ask George. Isn't he in Peterborough?…
